name: furnituregroups-simple
description: IXT-SUITES batch 4: furnitureGroups (pro) flag gate + Group/Ungroup buttons in the MultiSelectPanel (2+ items selected). Hidden in Simple even with 2 items selected, present in Pro; a real Group → Ungroup round-trip clears/sets item.groupId.

steps.name: dismiss-overlays
steps.eval: try { localStorage.setItem('hdb_onboarded','1') } catch {}; const s = window.__store.getState(); s.endTour?.(); s.setOnboardingOpen?.(false); s.dismissLocationPrompt?.()

steps.name: seed-items
steps.eval: (() => { const s = window.__store.getState(); const a = s.addItem({ defId: 'sofa-3seat', position: [10.0, 3.5], rotation: 0, props: {} }); const b = s.addItem({ defId: 'armchair', position: [11.0, 3.5], rotation: 0, props: {} }); window.__grpIds = [a, b]; s.setSelectedItemIds([a, b]); })()

steps.name: multiselect-visible
steps.failMessage: MultiSelectPanel did not mount for a 2-item selection

steps.name: assert-simple-hidden
steps.failMessage: furnitureGroups should be OFF in Simple mode

steps.name: assert-no-group-btn-simple
steps.eval: (() => { const has = [...document.querySelectorAll('button')].some(b => b.textContent.trim() === 'Group'); if (has) throw new Error('Group button should not render in Simple mode'); })()

steps.name: assert-pro-on
steps.failMessage: furnitureGroups should be ON in Pro mode

steps.name: group-btn-visible
steps.eval: (() => { const has = [...document.querySelectorAll('button')].some(b => b.textContent.trim() === 'Group'); if (!has) throw new Error('Group button should render in Pro mode with 2 items selected'); })()

steps.name: assert-grouped

waitFor.store: (() => { const s = window.__store.getState(); const [a,b] = window.__grpIds; const ia = s.items.find(i => i.id === a); const ib = s.items.find(i => i.id === b); return !!ia?.groupId && ia.groupId === ib?.groupId; })()

steps.failMessage: clicking Group should assign a shared groupId to both selected items

steps.name: mirror-active-group
steps.eval: (() => { const s = window.__store.getState(); const a = s.items.find(i => i.id === window.__grpIds[0]); window.__store.setState({ activeGroupId: a.groupId }); })()

steps.name: ungroup-btn-visible
steps.failMessage: Ungroup button should render once activeGroupId is set

steps.name: click-ungroup
steps.eval: (() => { const b = [...document.querySelectorAll('button')].find(el => el.textContent.trim() === 'Ungroup'); if (!b) throw new Error('Ungroup button not found'); b.click(); })()

steps.name: assert-ungrouped

waitFor.store: (() => { const s = window.__store.getState(); const [a,b] = window.__grpIds; const ia = s.items.find(i => i.id === a); const ib = s.items.find(i => i.id === b); return !ia?.groupId && !ib?.groupId; })()

steps.failMessage: clicking Ungroup should clear groupId from both items
